top_stories.title: Cisco Zero-Day Highlights API Endpoint Authentication Issues
top_stories.summary: A maximum-severity authentication bypass vulnerability (CVE-2026-76460) has been discovered in Cisco's Identity Services Engine (ISE), receiving a CVSS score of 10 out of 10. The zero-day flaw affects API endpoint authentication within Cisco's IAM/network access control platform.

top_stories.title: Cisco Warns of New Zero-Day ISE Auth Bypass (CVSS 10.0) Exploited in Active Attacks
top_stories.summary: Cisco has disclosed a maximum-severity (CVSS 10.0) zero-day vulnerability in its Identity Services Engine (ISE), tracked as CVE-2026-76460, that is actively being exploited in the wild. The flaw exists in an API endpoint with insufficient authentication controls, allowing unauthenticated remote attackers to bypass authentication entirely.

top_stories.title: The Pillar Cracks Three Ways: Azure Identity Infrastructure Takes Three Max-Severity Hits in One Patch Tuesday
top_stories.summary: Microsoft's September 2026 Patch Tuesday addressed three maximum-severity vulnerabilities in Azure's identity infrastructure, part of a record-breaking 964 CVE patch cycle. All three flaws targeted the Azure identity stack directly, representing a concentrated critical vulnerability cluster in core IAM infrastructure.

top_stories.title: The Gatekeeper Is the Door: Cisco ISE’s Nine-CVE Disclosure and the Identity Infrastructure Attack Surface
top_stories.summary: Cisco disclosed nine vulnerabilities in its Identity Services Engine (ISE), including multiple critical-severity flaws under active exploitation, with CVE-2026-76460 being an unauthenticated REST API flaw. ISE is a core NAC and policy enforcement platform widely used in enterprise identity and access infrastructure.

top_stories.title: Two Unauthenticated Lockpicks for the Enterprise Vault: Delinea Secret Server’s Double Critical Disclosure
top_stories.summary: Two critical unauthenticated vulnerabilities were disclosed in Delinea Secret Server, a privileged access management platform used to secure enterprise credentials. The flaws, disclosed on September 15, 2026, allow unauthenticated attackers to compromise the PAM vault, putting stored privileged credentials at risk.

news.title: CrowdSec Says TanStack npm Attack Led to Copy of 170 Private GitHub Repositories
news.summary: CrowdSec disclosed that an attacker copied approximately 170 private GitHub repositories on May 22 using credentials stolen from a former employee whose access had not been revoked. The incident stemmed from a supply chain attack on TanStack npm packages that harvested credentials, and was compounded by a failure to deprovision the departed employee's GitHub access.

news.title: MFA Won't Save You From OAuth Consent Abuse
news.summary: The article addresses the limitations of MFA in protecting against OAuth consent abuse attacks, where attackers exploit OAuth permission grants rather than stealing credentials. The piece argues that organizations need OAuth governance controls including least-privilege scopes, consent monitoring, and token revocation capabilities alongside MFA.

news.title: Fake LastPass Authenticator GitHub repos push new Rapuncel infostealer
news.summary: A malware campaign is using SEO-optimized GitHub repositories to impersonate LastPass Authenticator and other software firms to distribute a new infostealer called Rapuncel. The attack specifically targets authenticator/password manager users by spoofing a well-known IAM-adjacent tool to trick victims into downloading malicious software.

news.title: Secure enterprise sharing with access reviews for Microsoft 365
news.summary: tenfold Software has published guidance on managing persistent file access in Microsoft 365 through centralized access governance and owner-driven access reviews. The piece focuses on identifying and removing unnecessary access permissions that outlast their original purpose, addressing a core identity governance challenge in enterprise environments.

news.title: Hardcoded MCP credentials found in public GitHub files
news.summary: Hush Security's research found that 12% of credential slots in publicly accessible MCP configuration files on GitHub contained hardcoded credential literals, including API keys and access tokens used by AI coding tools. The analysis covered approximately 82,000 configuration files, revealing exposure of credentials for connected services and systems.

news.title: 98% of fraudulent hires have company credentials by the time they’re caught
news.summary: HYPR's State of HR Identity Fraud Detection report finds that 98% of fraudulent hires already possess company credentials by the time they are identified. The report highlights a 90-day hiring-to-onboarding gap as a critical vulnerability in enterprise identity security, where adversaries exploit remote hiring processes to obtain legitimate credentials without breaching networks.

news.title: Microsoft Patches CVSS 10.0 Azure AI Foundry Flaw Enabling Unauthorized Privilege Escalation
news.summary: Microsoft patched a CVSS 10.0 vulnerability in Azure AI Foundry (CVE-2026-85889) that allowed unauthorized attackers to escalate privileges over a network due to missing authentication for a critical function. The fix was applied server-side and requires no action from customers.

news.title: What Recent AI-Powered Attacks Mean for Your Identity Security
news.summary: Specops published analysis on how AI-powered attacks are accelerating credential theft and identity-based threats. The piece argues that identity security must extend beyond authentication to include device trust verification as part of access decisions.

news.title: keycloak v26.7.4
news.summary: Keycloak has released version 26.7.4 of its open source identity and access management platform. This is a maintenance/patch release of the widely-used IAM solution for modern applications and services.

news.title: vault v2.1.1
news.summary: Vault version 2.1.1 has been released as a tool supporting secrets management, encryption as a service, and privileged access management. No specific details about changes, fixes, or new features in this release are provided in the description.

news.title: Microsoft Entra Agent ID Expands with MCP Firewall, Adding Network-Level Control to Agent Governance
news.summary: Microsoft is expanding its Entra Agent ID governance framework with the introduction of an MCP Firewall, adding network-level control to AI agent management. The new capability provides security teams with additional controls to govern AI agents operating in enterprise production environments under the Microsoft Entra identity platform.

news.title: Implementing defense-in-depth authorization for MCP tools on Amazon Quick
news.summary: The article provides a technical walkthrough for implementing defense-in-depth authorization for Model Context Protocol (MCP) tools on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Gateway. The implementation uses Microsoft Entra ID group and claims-based JWTs to enforce per-user, per-tool access controls through an interceptor pattern.

news.title: Amplifier Extends Workforce Security to the AI Agents Employees Build and Use
news.summary: Amplifier Security launched Agent Intent & Posture Management, a capability that connects discovered AI agents to employee owners, documents each agent's stated purpose, and guides risk remediation. The product extends workforce security to AI agents built and used by employees, addressing identity and access governance concerns around non-human identities.

news.title: Druva expands identity resilience with ransomware detection
news.summary: Druva has announced new capabilities for its Identity Resilience product, including a Ransomware Detection feature powered by a proprietary AI threat pipeline called Dru MetaGraph. The solution uses behavioral intelligence to detect identity-related threats.

news.title: Keeper Security and SailPoint Partner to Automate Privileged Access Governance
news.summary: Keeper Security and SailPoint have announced a partnership to integrate SailPoint's Identity Governance and Administration (IGA) platform with Keeper's Identity Security Platform. The integration aims to automate privileged access governance across all identities using a zero-trust approach.

news.title: Okta CEO Todd McKinnon goes one-on-one with Jim Cramer
news.summary: Okta CEO Todd McKinnon appeared on CNBC's Mad Money with Jim Cramer to discuss AI agents, quarterly results, and the company's future. The conversation covered Okta's business performance and strategic direction around AI and identity.

news.title: Keeper Security、SailPointとの連携により特権アクセスガバナンスを自動化
news.summary: Keeper Security has announced an integration with SailPoint to automate privileged access governance. The partnership connects Keeper's PAM capabilities with SailPoint's identity governance platform to streamline access lifecycle management.

news.title: N0va Phishkit Targets US and EU Businesses: A New Challenge for Identity Security
news.summary: A phishing kit called N0va is targeting organizations in the US and EU by impersonating trusted services and abusing legitimate authentication flows to compromise user identities. The attacks focus on obtaining valid account credentials without malware, allowing threat actors to move laterally through cloud systems using a single compromised identity.

news.title: SailPoint (SAIL) Reaches $1.2 Billion ARR. Can AI Growth Lift Revenue and Cash Flow?
news.summary: SailPoint reported fiscal Q2 2027 revenue of $308.8 million, a 17% year-over-year increase, while reaching $1.2 billion in annual recurring revenue. The company is highlighting AI-driven growth as a factor in its financial performance.

news.title: CISA and NIST Issue Guidance to Protect Cloud Identity Tokens
news.summary: CISA and NIST have released final guidance aimed at protecting cloud identity tokens and assertions. The guidance targets the security of token-based authentication mechanisms used in cloud environments, addressing a critical component of modern identity infrastructure.

news.title: Quest Software Takes Aim at Rogue AI Agents as Identity Security Threats Drive 90% of Cyber Incidents
news.summary: Quest Software announced a major expansion of its Quest Security Manager platform, positioning it as a NIST-aligned identity security solution designed to address AI agent-related identity threats. The platform aims to expose identity risk, contain lateral movement, and accelerate recovery of critical operations, targeting enterprises facing identity-based cyber incidents.

news.title: EU Cyber Resilience Act to Enforce New Reporting Requirements
news.summary: The EU Cyber Resilience Act begins enforcing a 24-hour mandatory reporting requirement for serious product security incidents affecting European organizations. This regulation introduces new compliance obligations relevant to IAM vendors and enterprise security teams operating in the EU.

news.title: Microsoft Plugs Nearly 1,000 Security Holes
news.summary: Microsoft released a record-breaking patch batch fixing at least 974 security vulnerabilities across Windows and other software. Microsoft attributed the accelerated vulnerability discovery pace to AI assistance, while security experts noted organizations are struggling to prioritize and deploy the high volume of monthly patches.

news.title: FBI Probes Service Selling 153M+ Drivers Licenses
news.summary: A dark web service is selling digital scans of over 153 million drivers licenses from the US and Canada, apparently sourced from a Louisiana-based identity verification company. The FBI's New Orleans field office has launched an official inquiry into the breach of the identity verification provider.

news.title: Canadian Man Pleads Guilty in Snowflake Extortions
news.summary: Canadian man Connor Riley Moucka pleaded guilty to computer fraud and conspiracy charges related to hacking and extorting over 165 organizations using Snowflake cloud storage. The attacks involved credential-based unauthorized access to Snowflake customer accounts, resulting in massive data theft including 100 million AT&T customer records.
